lines: Me
—Ugh... gulp... huh...?
A soft feeling under my head; apparently I was sleeping—no, that's not it.
Me
Right, it was... Soniko's strike—
In my carelessness—truly careless—I'd been knocked out by a novice's sword.
No mercy for such a pathetic guy; I was only given a pillow and left lying on the ground.
Me
Damn, such a cold-hearted classmate...
I guess it's jealousy over me handling the idol alone.
Me
But I can't help it, that was a request from the teacher after all.
Me
(Well, it did give me some perks, though.)
While thinking that, a smile of amusement crossed my face—
Soniko
Ah, looks like you noticed... Are you okay, Fuma-san?
Me
Eh—
When I looked up at the voice, there were the familiar large breasts and Soniko's face peeking over them.
Me
Soniko!? Huh, why—Whoa!?
Only then did I realize that under my head wasn't a pillow, but Soniko's lap pillow.
Me
S-sorry, I'll get up right away!
Soniko
Ah, no, don't move yet...
Me
But making you do this, I'd be really sorry!
The root cause was my perverted mind; I'm doubly sorry.
Soniko
Because I beat you, I thought you'd stay until you could stand again... Ah, you still mustn't get up, okay?
When I tried to force myself up, she pressed her hand against my forehead as if to soothe it.
A slight pain eased at the back of my head; some damage still lingered.
Me
Then... just a little longer.
Soniko
That's better. You still look sore... there, there.
Me
(Angel)
Feeling the comfort of her caressing hand, I focused all my senses on my head, imprinting the feel of her hand and thigh.
Soniko
Do you always get such serious injuries?
The Angel spoke to me to cleanse my ulterior motives.
Me
This isn’t even a real injury. Usually I’d force myself to get up and keep training even harder than before.
Soniko
What a tough job, being a Taimanin… Kids almost my age doing this kind of training every day…
Seeing a glimpse of a world she hadn’t known, perhaps from the shock of witnessing it, Soniko murmured with deep feeling.
Soniko
All of it is to protect peace… Thank you so much. It’s something I could never do.
Me
No—well, how should I put it…
Her final words carried a hint of self‑mockery.
Self‑mockery—perhaps self‑reproach, guilt, a feeling of apologizing for pushing what she can’t do onto others.
Because she’s kind‑hearted, even the natural order of the world, once she notices its absurdity, she worries about it.
Me
…Everyone has different abilities. Doing what you can is what matters.
Soniko
But—
Me
I can never make people smile through music or gravure work.
Me
But you, Soniko, you can… You saw the kids at our school, right?
A crowd of fans went wild over Soniko’s appearance—.
Me
You lift so many people, give them energy. That’s surely your battle.
A battle isn’t just finding enemies and cutting them down.
Providing nourishment and vigor for tomorrow to many is also a battle.
Soniko
…My battle, huh…
I don’t know if my words reached her, but her face seemed brighter than before.
Soniko
Thank you, Fuma‑san. I… I want to keep doing my best, make everyone smile, more and more.
Me
I’m sure you can… I’m cheering you on too.
Soniko
Hehe... I somehow end up being troubled. I try to cheer everyone up, but I ended up getting energy from them.
So, does that mean... with those words just now—?
Me
No, um... it's nothing special—
Stared at by her smiling face and pure eyes, I, uncharacteristically, got all flustered.
Me
I-I'm gonna go now! Um, thanks for the lap pillow—whoa!
Soniko
Not yet... please rest a little longer.
Me
...Sure.
No, this is different.
Me
(This... is that I'm deliberately taking advantage of Soniko's kindness, just to not waste her generosity.)
Being gently held down, her thighs pressed softly against the back of my head—not that I'm dying from happiness.
Let alone—.
Her chest, pressed against my face with overwhelming force, wasn't something I was savoring.
Soniko
I'll rest until the pain stops. In the meantime, I'll give you energy. Power, poof~♪
Me
Okay.
It actually feels like she's pouring power into me.
I just want to take her pure feelings and have her work comfortably.
I have no ill intent toward the word "energy"; I calmly rest my head on the lap pillow.
Me
(But if Aishu or Uehara Shikanosuke found out, they'd definitely have a lot to say.)
Thinking about that is a hassle, but it wasn't enough reason to give up the paradise before me.
